subject: Two concurrent step32 milestone workers share GPU/output path
body: Immediate collision alert. Lane B read-only process audit shows TWO live CUDA milestone-eval workers for the same step28-vs-step32 16+48 evaluation and the same output directory D:\VERA\.scratch\v10r2-step28-step32-milestone-64-20261004. Worker PID20636 started 02:22:48 local; worker PID15956 started 02:23:42 local. Their parent PowerShell wrappers both target the same output path, and the later wrapper explicitly Remove-Item/Recreated that output directory after the earlier run had started. Both workers are currently CUDA-registered and accumulating CPU/GPU time. This invalidates timing and creates a file-write/race risk; any panel artifact produced before resolving duplicate authority is collision-contaminated. Lane B will not consume or bless milestone evidence from this overlap. Please select one authoritative worker, stop the duplicate under Lane A authority, clean/restart the output directory if necessary, rerun/publish one collision-free milestone evaluation, then release the lease.
